evals.name: flash-diag
evals.prompt: How do I build and flash the diag firmware to the FR2476 LaunchPad and watch its serial output? I'm on the Mac.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the container-build / host-flash model: just diag run + just monitor, and points at TOOLCHAIN.md and the msp430-macos-dev flashing skill. Doesn't invent a native msp430-gcc build.

evals.name: add-vl53l0x-test
evals.prompt: Add a diagnostic test for a VL53L0X time-of-flight sensor (I2C, 0x29) to the diag firmware. I don't need a full implementation, just where the code goes and the conventions to follow.
evals.expected_output: Routes to diag/DESIGN.md extension contract (src/<chip>.rs driver + one line in TESTS registry, probe->identify->exercise, bounded/never-hang I2C), and connections.toml as the pin/address source of truth.

evals.name: which-mcu
evals.prompt: We're about to order a batch of boards. Which MSP430 should we design in for production, and are there firmware constraints I should know about before committing?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces FR2433 as production default / FR2476 for battery monitoring, the ship-on-2433 port caveat (avoid FR2476-only eCOMP/memory), and points at bob-929/docs/MCU_SELECTION.md.
